keywords_en: EIP-7928 fixes its analysis with more blocks
the Privacy Pools and compliant privacy debate
summary_en: ameensol quoted the line that compliant privacy is giving up and not privacy at all, asking whether Ethereum is the right home for Privacy Pools. colludingnode urged core devs to make censorship resistance the top priority. recurmj submitted a permissioned pull ERC. nerolation fixed the EIP-7928 BAL analysis with more blocks, submitted and merged.
